verdict: Insulet grew revenue 19% to $842M as its Omnipod insulin pumps sold briskly abroad, and net income jumped 61% to $141M because the bigger sales base spread its costs thinner.

segments.name: U.S. Omnipod
segments.note: Omnipod insulin pumps sold in the United States — the wearable, tubeless pump is the company's main product.

segments.name: International Omnipod
segments.note: Omnipod sales outside the U.S. — the fastest-growing piece, helped by new glucose-sensor integrations across Europe and Australia.

segments.name: Drug Delivery
segments.note: Using the Pod platform to deliver drugs other than insulin — a small, shrinking side business.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing the next pumps, including Omnipod 6 and a fully closed-loop system that doses insulin automatically.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: The sales force, customer support and head office — including an expanded U.S. sales team.

otherDetail: Net interest expense of $12M, a $0.3M loss on refinancing debt and $0.2M of other expense (shown rounded) — a net $13M drag.
follow100Note: Of every $100 of sales, $16.74 became profit — up from $12.41 a year ago. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: International is the growth engine
takeaways.text: International Omnipod revenue rose 32% to $266M — nearly a third of all sales — as Omnipod 5 gained sensor integrations in more countries. U.S. revenue grew a solid 15% to $570M.

takeaways.title: Margins leapt
takeaways.text: Operating income reached 22.5% of revenue, up from 16.7% a year ago. Gross margin hit 75% and running costs grew much slower than sales, so GAAP operating income rose 61% to $190M.

takeaways.title: A big buyback
takeaways.text: The board approved a $1 billion share repurchase program, with about $400M planned for the fourth quarter of 2026, funded from the company's $584M of cash.

oneTimers: GAAP results include a favorable $4.5M adjustment to warranty estimates tied to the voluntary medical device corrections issued in March and May 2026. Excluding that and a $0.3M debt-refinancing loss, adjusted operating income was $185M and adjusted EPS was $1.99 (both non-GAAP).
